BRB1#0.quote: Situated 14 km from Sawai Madhopur, the Ranthambore Park gets its name from the Ranthambore Fort situated within its boundaries.

BRB1#1.quote: The National Park, situated amidst the Aravalis and Vindhya ranges is spreads over an area of 392 sq.km of thick forest punctuated with pleasant waterfalls.

BRB1#2.quote: It is home to the elusive tiger, other animals found here include chinkara, sambhar, cheetal and over 300 species of birds.

BRB2#0.quote: One of the best ways to observe wildlife at the Ranthambore National Park is through a safari.

BRB2#1.quote: Apart from the royal Bengal tiger, you can also spot sloth bears, leopards, jackals, foxes and hyenas.

BRB3#0.quote: You can easily get regular trains to Sawai Madhopur from other major cities of the country.
